scope.session_definition: Cash-equity REGULAR/CORE session only (NYSE Core Trading Session; Nasdaq Stock Market regular hours). Pre-market, after-hours, and late sessions are NOT treated as the mechanism open window.
scope.venue_coverage_policy: Both NYSE and Nasdaq official 2026 holiday/early-close lists were fetched independently. Dates agree exactly for full holidays and early closes. Regular hours agree (09:30-16:00 ET). This table is a joint NYSE+Nasdaq regular-session calendar for 2026, NOT a silent NYSE-only overlay onto Nasdaq.
scope.etf_note: Neither official source enumerates ETF vs common-stock exceptions inside this calendar artifact. ETFs listed on NYSE/Nasdaq that observe the same exchange holiday schedule are covered by venue calendar identity only when separately proven listed on those venues; this file does not assert per-symbol ETF coverage.
scope.pit_policy: KnownFrom equals the earliest successful official HTML fetch timestamp in this lookup batch. This artifact must NOT be used to backfill pre-KnownFrom rule changes; it is a versioned as-of snapshot of the exchanges published 2026 calendars as retrieved on KnownFrom.
not_covering: futures/options early-close nuances beyond equity 1:00 p.m. ET early closes

source_evidence.nyse: NYSE Holidays & Trading Hours page: Core Trading Session 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET
source_evidence.nasdaq: Nasdaq U.S. Stock Market Holiday Schedule page: Opens 9:30 am ET / Closes 4:00 pm ET

dst_transitions_america_new_york_2026.dst_starts: 2026-03-08T02:00:00 America/New_York (second Sunday in March; clocks spring forward)
dst_transitions_america_new_york_2026.dst_ends: 2026-11-01T02:00:00 America/New_York (first Sunday in November; clocks fall back)
dst_transitions_america_new_york_2026.computation: Per-session open/close UTC derived via IANA America/New_York (zoneinfo) at construction time; dst_in_effect flag set from open local datetime.

official_sources.note: Fetched as corroborating official PDF; HTML holidays/hours page used as primary parseable text source because pdftotext was unavailable in this environment.
Fetched; not text-parsed (no pdftotext). HTML Nasdaq sources already provide the holiday/early-close list.

explicitly_not_used_as_official.reason: HTTP 403 at fetch time; not used as evidence despite being an ICE press release URL.
